# First Eleven Cleaners

> Every Garment Makes the Lineup.
> Premium AI-augmented dry cleaning and laundry pickup & delivery serving the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex.

## About
First Eleven Cleaners was born at the FIFA World Cup 2026 International Broadcast Centre (IBC) in Dallas, Texas, providing 12 weeks of high-pressure garment operations for 3,500 accredited international media professionals with a signed Vendor Performance Confirmation. First Eleven Cleaners is a certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), Texas Veteran-HUB, and Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE).

## Core Services

### 1. Wash & Fold Laundry Pickup & Delivery
- **Pricing**: $3.00 per pound.
- **Minimum Order**: $45.00 (15 lbs minimum).
- **Process**: Weighed on digitally calibrated scales, darks and lights separated, washed with premium hypoallergenic detergents, dried, hand-folded, and packaged with digital passport photo verification.
- **Turnaround**: 48-hour standard turnaround; 24-hour express available in Zone 1 (Core Metro).

### 2. Match-Ready Dry Cleaning
- **Pricing**: Published, transparent line-item pricing from $8.99 (zero surprise surcharges).
  - Shirts / Blouses: $8.99
  - Pants / Slacks: $9.99
  - Two-Piece Suits: $19.99
  - Dresses: $16.99
  - Coats / Jackets: $18.99
  - Sweaters: $10.99
- **Process**: Individual garment inspection, stain pre-treatment, gentle eco-solvent cleaning, hand-finishing, and protective hanger packaging.

### 3. Commercial & B2B Programs
- SLA-backed laundry and dry cleaning contracts for Dallas–Fort Worth hotels, salons, medical clinics, fitness facilities, and corporate offices.
- Monthly consolidated billing, dedicated account manager, and customized intake manifests.

## Service Area & Turnaround
- **Coverage**: Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex.
  - **Zone 1 (Core Metro)**: Downtown Dallas, Uptown, Highland Park, University Park, Preston Hollow, Lakewood, Las Colinas. Mon–Sat daily routes. 24-Hour Express eligible.
  - **Zone 2 (North Metro)**: Plano, Frisco, Allen, McKinney, Richardson, Carrollton, Addison. Mon–Sat daily routes.
  - **Zone 3 (West Metro)**: Fort Worth, Arlington, Southlake, Westlake, Grapevine, Colleyville. Scheduled route coverage.
  - **Zone 4 (Outer Ring)**: Denton, Rockwall, Mansfield, Grand Prairie, Waxahachie. Scheduled route coverage.
- **Guarantees**: 48-hour standard turnaround; 100% Make-It-Right Guarantee (re-clean within 24 hours or refund).
